title: 第6章 美男嗔怒
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀

第(1/3)页

【宿主，请不要再屏蔽系统，不要再做这种影响系统和宿主之间友爱关系的行为】

“我就说你这坏统不安好心！”

昭杺柠张口就是问候：“天道姻缘线绑定是双方同生共死这个消息你就瞒着我，还想骗我解除姻缘。”

“这么好的保命符，我凭什么解除？”

“我就说了，你这系统不行，当系统都当不明白，还做任务呢，屏蔽了哈。”

将系统一通骂完，昭杺柠手速很快，在系统回怼之前再次将系统屏蔽。

此刻，昭杺柠对自己往后会被六个男主追杀的任务信心满满。

如果有天道姻缘同生共死这个buff加持，她很有信心，挑衅男主们以后还有命活着。

连带着对刚刚说出天道姻缘线最重要的消息是同生共死的钟离珟都好感飙升。

意识到绑定自己的这个系统不好安心，而自己对这个星灵大陆的了解更是没有。

昭杺柠明白，眼下她最重要的，是在星灵大陆找个向导，或者说信息顾问。

而这个人员……

昭杺柠抬头，直接星星眼满是期待盯着钟离珟看。

钟离珟左脸的巴掌印虽然消了，但脸颊还残留着红印。

他看着前不久刚嘲讽自己的昭杺柠，此刻突然转变态度，眸色一沉。

直觉告诉他，昭杺柠突然转变态度，绝对不安好心。

正这样想着，钟离珟就看见昭杺柠主动向他靠近，更是伸手动作亲昵挽上他胳膊。

昭杺柠还自来熟对他询问：“刚刚不是说问天宗宗主要见我吗，我们什么时候去呀？”

“你……”钟离珟蹙眉，对上的却是昭杺柠对他灿烂又甜美的笑容：“我怎么啦？未婚夫。”

“你又耍什么把戏？”对于昭杺柠，钟离珟依旧怀疑。

“你看你，又犯疑心病了。”昭杺柠啧笑：“刚刚你误会我勾结魔族一事，你道歉了，所以我原谅你了。”

“而且你也说了，我们是天道姻缘，作为夫妻我们同生共死，我能对你有什么坏心思呢？”

“我不远万里就是来寻你的啊，我亲爱的未婚夫。”

[Host, please stop blocking the system and do not do this kind of behavior that affects the friendly relationship between the system and the host]

"I'm just telling you that you're such a bad leader and don't have good intentions!"

Zhao Hao Ning opened her mouth to say hello: "You hid the news from me that the marriage line of heaven is bound to live and die together, and you also wanted to trick me into breaking off the marriage."

"Why should I cancel such a good life-saving charm?"

"I just said, your system is not good. You pretend that the system doesn't understand it and you are still doing tasks. It's blocked."

After scolding the system, Zhao Hao Ning moved quickly and blocked the system again before it could reply.

At this moment, Zhao Haining is full of confidence in her future mission of being hunted down by six male protagonists.

If she had the buff blessing of destiny and destiny, she would be very confident that she would still be alive after provoking the male protagonists.

Even Zhong Lizui, who had just revealed the most important news about the marriage line of heaven and earth, that they would live and die together, had a soaring impression.

I realized that the system that bound me was not at ease, and I didn't know much about this continent of stars.

Zhao Haining understood that the most important thing for her right now was to find a guide, or information consultant, in the Protoss Continent.

And this person...

Zhao Hao Ning raised her head and stared at Zhong Lizui with starry eyes full of expectation.

Although the slap mark on the left side of Zhong Lizou's face disappeared, the red mark still remained on his cheek.

He looked at Zhao Hao Ning, who had just mocked him not long ago, and now his attitude suddenly changed, and his eyes darkened.

His intuition told him that Zhao Hao Ning's sudden change of attitude was definitely unkind.

Just as he was thinking this, Zhong Lizui saw Zhao Hao Ning approaching him actively, and even reached out to take his arm affectionately.

Zhao Hao Ning also asked him, "Didn't I just ask the Tianzong Master to see me? When should we go?"

"You..." Zhongli Sui frowned, but Zhao Hao Ning gave him a bright and sweet smile: "What's wrong with me? Fiancé."

"What tricks are you playing again?" Zhong Lizui was still suspicious of Zhao Hao Ning.

"Look, you are being suspicious again." Zhao Hao Ning chuckled: "You just misunderstood me about colluding with the demons, and you apologized, so I forgive you."

"And you also said that we are destined to be married by heaven. As husband and wife, we will live and die together. What bad thoughts can I have towards you?"

"I have traveled thousands of miles to find you, my dear fiancé."
